items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: specially with Leont Eddies up there

ctx.x: Had 52nd street changed very much at all?

Yeah, Rockefeller was buying everything --- tearing it down, and made new things --- It should have been a landmark, that place, specially with Leont Eddies up there, and Clubs right next door to each other --- a lot of landmarks should be left alone. --- They could have built around it but they didn't. So that was the end of 52nd street.
I want to ask you more about the system of your guitar playing.
